title: GRASP: Graph Agentic Search over Propositions for Multi-hop Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2605.16598v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic retrieval improves multi-hop question answering by giving language models autonomy to iteratively gather evidence. Recent work augments these systems with knowledge graphs for structured traversal, but this combination introduces significant cost: expensive graph construction at index time and compounding token usage at inference time. We introduce Graph Agentic Search over Propositions (GRASP), an agentic system that simultaneously optimizes for high accuracy and minimal token usage in multi-hop question answering. Rather than executing a rigid, singular query, GRASP actively coordinates its retrieval strategy by decomposing multi-hop queries into dependency-aware plans. This enables GRASP to dynamically scale the number of sub-agents according to the complexity of the problem. translated_title: GRASP：面向多跳问答的基于命题的图智能体搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.16598v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：智能体检索通过赋予语言模型自主迭代收集证据的能力，从而提升了多跳问答的性能。近期工作通过引入知识图谱为这些系统提供结构化遍历能力，但这种组合带来了显著的开销：索引阶段昂贵的图谱构建成本，以及推理阶段不断累积的token消耗。我们提出了基于命题的图智能体搜索（GRASP），这是一个在多跳问答中同时优化高准确率与最小token使用量的智能体系统。GRASP并非执行僵化的单一查询，而是通过将多跳查询分解为具有依赖感知的规划来主动协调其检索策略。这使得GRASP能够根据问题的复杂程度动态调整子智能体的数量。每个子智能体通过探索一种新颖的三层层次图——包含实体、命题和段落——来解决其单跳查询……
tldr: GRASP通过将多跳查询分解为依赖感知的规划并动态调度子智能体，在由实体、命题和段落组成的三层层次图上进行智能体检索，从而在多跳问答中同时实现高准确率与最小token消耗。
en_tdlr: GRASP is an agentic search system that decomposes multi-hop queries into dependency-aware plans and dynamically scales sub-agents to explore a novel three-layer hierarchical graph of entities, propositions, and passages, achieving both high accuracy and minimal token usage in multi-hop question answering.
